description: The bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three distinct methods: Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue). The horizontal axis categorizes the models, while the vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," ranges from 3.0 to 6.0. For each model, three bars represent the entropy results of the respective methods. In GPT-4, the Source Info method yields the highest average entropy (approximately 5.25), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.05) and Baseline (approximately 4.9). For Claude, the Source Info method again shows the highest entropy (approximately 5.15), followed by Direct Command (approximately 4.95) and Baseline (approximately 4.7). In Llama, the Source Info method has the highest entropy (approximately 4.95), followed by Direct Command (approximately 4.85) and Baseline (approximately 4.55). The chart indicates that the Source Info method generally results in higher average entropy across all three models compared to the Baseline and Direct Command methods.
